title: Job output is empty in the next job with the warning 'Skip output since it may contain secret'
symptoms: Warning: Skip output 'url' since it may contain secret.
Happens when the value includes a secret or a substring that matches one
cause: The runner redacts any job output that contains a registered secret value and does not send it to later jobs. A short or common secret value can match ordinary output text.
fix: Pass non secret identifiers between jobs and fetch the sensitive value again in the job that needs it, or use an artifact for data.
apply:
# job A
- run: echo "deploy_id=$ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
# job B: look the secret up again
- run: ./deploy.sh "${{ needs.a.outputs.deploy_id }}"
  env:
    API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }}
affected: GitHub Actions job outputs, as of October 2026
